title: War of the Spark Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of fighting to give someone else a chance.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who leads a vast Eternal army and vows that even gods shall kneel.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon, Bolas's brother.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Bolas's realm, connected to him by a gem.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of using an enemy's attack as a weapon.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who seized command of Bolas's army using the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact worn by Liliana as she commands the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's vast army of Eternals.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who commands Vitu-Ghazi to advance on the Eternal armies.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya treetop city, awakened by Nissa to advance on the Eternals.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Dovin accuses of putting a match to what she does not understand.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who rebukes Chandra.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Gruul leader who proclaims that Ravnica's ancient places awaken at Ilharg's hoofbeats.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: A huge boar whose hoofbeats awaken Ravnica's ancient places.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who pledges to keep watch.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros angel who speaks of light as the primary weapon.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Planeswalker who realized too late what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of temporal study.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker golem who vows to protect those he can.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane under attack by the Eternal armies.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: An advokist who ties the law into knots.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Goblin kingpin of Tin Street.

events.summary: Bolas's army advances and Ravnica's heart disappears before anyone can defend it.
events.quote: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.

events.summary: Ugin identifies the gem linking Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to Bolas's downfall.
events.quote: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

events.summary: Liliana seizes the reins of Bolas's vast army while wearing the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army

events.summary: Nissa commands Vitu-Ghazi to advance on the Eternal armies.
events.quote: At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.

events.summary: Dovin tells Chandra that she has learned nothing.
events.quote: I see you've learned nothing, Chandra.

events.summary: Domri realizes what kind of master he has served as an Eternal's hand tightens on his throat.
events.quote: Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

events.summary: Nikya proclaims the awakening of Ravnica's ancient places at Ilharg's hoofbeats.
events.quote: The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!

events.summary: Karn vows to protect those he can.
events.quote: But those I can, I will.

relations.note: Liliana takes command of Bolas's army.
relations.quote: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army
At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.

relations.note: Domri rushed to serve a master who proved cruel.
relations.quote: what kind of master he had rushed to serve

rejected.summary: Angels bring the dawn after the sky boils over the citadel.
rejected.quote: Then the angels brought the dawn.
